exchanges: so i finally made it to memphis after like eleven hours of driving and my back is wrecked but the apartment is actually nicer than the pictures
Glad you made it in one piece. It is nice when a place beats the listing.
yeah its in Midtown which everyone at the interview said is the good part of town so fingers crossed
Sounds like a good pick for a first place.
the job is at Ridgeline the big distribution hub out by the airport i start next week
A hub that size must keep you busy. Are you nervous?
a little im going to be a shift supervisor over like forty people which is way more than my last place
That is a big step up. You will find your rhythm.
my sister fatima keeps texting me to send pics of everything she is so nosy lol she is pregnant and bored
Sounds like she misses you already. How far along is she?
she is due in February so not long now and i feel bad i moved so far away right before
You can still visit, and video calls help a lot.
true my mom is gonna fly up to be with her anyway
That must be a relief for everyone.
ok random but does memphis bbq live up to the hype because brisket is basically my religion
By most accounts it does, though Memphis is better known for ribs.
lol ok ill find the best spot and report back
Looking forward to the verdict.
met my neighbour dolores this morning she has the sweetest old dog named Peaches who just sat on my foot
That is a friendly welcome. What kind of dog?
a Beagle i think kind of chubby
They do love their snacks.
also my brother yusuf is losing his mind because the Raptors lost again he takes it so personally
Some fans live and die with every game.
meanwhile i only care about basketball here now im all in on the Grizzlies gonna catch a game soon
Quick convert. That will make for good small talk at work.
my coworker mateo who showed me around on the tour is super into fishing he goes out on the river every weekend
A good way to unwind after warehouse shifts.
he invited me to come but i would probably fall in
Maybe start from the bank then.
oh and yusufs wife leila is ALSO pregnant so my family is about to double
Two new babies, that is a lot of good news.
leila is due in April so like two months after fatima which is chaos for my mom
Your mom is going to be very busy this spring.
very busy lol. ok i bought a recliner today because i had literally nothing to sit on
Smart first purchase. Comfort matters after long shifts.
my college buddy kwame says he might move down to Atlanta which would be only like six hours from here
That would be nice to have a friend within driving distance.
and i have a dentist appointment on Friday morning which i booked before even unpacking my plates
Getting that sorted early is very organised of you.
haha organised is not the word i would use for my kitchen right now
Unpacking always takes longer than planned.
ok correction kwame just texted its Nashville not atlanta his job offer is there
Even closer then, that is good news.
yes only three hours i can go see him on weekends
Weekend trips will be easy.
the heat here is something else btw its like walking into a dryer
Summers here are famously humid.
also need to figure out the bus bc parking at the hub costs a fortune
Worth checking if there is a shuttle from your area.
wait when is my sister in laws baby due again
mateo says i have to try Sunnyside for breakfast its his favourite place
Worth a try if a local swears by it.
ok im gonna go find some dinner before i pass out
Enjoy, and get some rest after the drive.
